reviews.comment:
Estuvimos de paso desde chile a Argentina, te reciben usd, pesos argentinos y pesos chilenos y reciben tarjetas. Tienen café al paso con medialunas y menú de comida, bastante rico (me pedí una Mila napolitana con papas) No se paga para usar el baño como si lo hacen en chile. tiene wifi para estar comunicado. La gente muy atenta y amable

(Translated by Google)
We were passing through on our way from Chile to Argentina. They accept USD, Argentine pesos, and Chilean pesos, and they also accept credit cards. They have coffee to go with croissants and a food menu, which was quite good (I ordered a milanesa napolitana with fries). You don't have to pay to use the bathroom, unlike in Chile. They have Wi-Fi to stay connected. The staff was very attentive and friendly.

reviews.comment:
Llegue a las 11 de la mañana del día 15/01 y tuve que esperar 3 horas que descarguen el combustible, viendo el camión parado dos horas seguidas sin descargarlo, un vez que realice la carga de nafta no me cargaron los puntos de ypf servíclub y no me ofrecieron factura ni ticket, una sola persona atendiendo el full y un solo playero para atender las filas interminables para la carga de combustible

(Translated by Google)
I arrived at 11 am on January 15th and had to wait 3 hours for them to unload the fuel, watching the truck sit for two hours straight without unloading. Once I filled up, they didn't credit my YPF Serviclub points and didn't offer me an invoice or receipt. There was only one person working the full service station and only one attendant to manage the endless lines for refueling.
